security.summary: The pack contains only vehicle assets and metadata. The uploaded fxmanifest.lua has rude text and stale broad file declarations, but no executable or network behavior. The importer will ignore the uploaded manifest and rebuild a fresh one from existing assets only.

findings.reason: Manifest contains only declarative resource metadata; no scripts, process execution, network calls, or dynamic code execution are present.
Several declared data_file entries reference missing optional metadata paths, but these are harmless because the importer rebuilds the manifest from actual files only.
The description text is hostile/profane but not a security threat.

repairs.issue: Stale or missing metadata declarations in the uploaded manifest.
repairs.action: Omit missing optional entries when generating the new manifest; keep only declarations for files that exist.
